replies.author: RunsaberSR
replies.body:
The HUD clutter has since been more modernized and trimmed down. Should have seen it before, really messy.

Map wise I’m actually working on that right now. The city at different times of day comes off as a big color wall often.

There’s an ocean, grasslands, forest and a few beaches but I was kinda having fun flying in the city. I have a rough canyon area but haven’t gotten back to it yet.

Also space exists, just nothing can fly there just yet. Gives a flame out, but the ceiling of whatever the ISS orbit altitude is (I forgot).

Something for later.
